backend/main.mo: Motoko backend handling user profiles, contact inquiries with admin controls, and editable site content with default values.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented UI/content updates, associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file’s purpose and recent updates.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining OKLCH color variables, dark mode defaults, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting dark mode, updated meta tags, and favicon links for ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component switching between home and admin views and rendering all main site sections with site content data.
frontend/src/components/admin/SiteConten: Admin panel form allowing editing and saving all site content fields with loading and update states.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Unauthorized-access screen showing login option or message and a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: A login/logout button that manages Internet Identity authentication and resets queries on logout.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Displays an About section with heading, description, and a grid of service-related feature cards.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Provides a contact form with validation, inquiry submission, and contact details support.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: A hero banner with video or fallback image, main headings, call-to-action buttons, and stats.
frontend/src/components/sections/Ratings: Lets users submit star ratings and comments while showing recent and average ratings.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards with images, descriptions, and a contact scroll action.
frontend/src/components/site/CookieConse: Displays a dismissible cookie/local‑storage consent banner using localStorage to save preference.
frontend/src/components/site/Footer.tsx: React footer with logo lightbox, navigation buttons that scroll to sections, social icons, and service listings.
frontend/src/components/site/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo lightbox, desktop and mobile navigation, and smooth scrolling to page sections.
frontend/src/components/site/LogoLightbo: Modal lightbox that displays an enlarged logo and disables page scrolling until closed.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Exports static email and phone contact information.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for creating and fetching inquiries and website ratings, plus helpers for parsing inquiry messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteContent.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and updating site content with fallbacks and toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining theme color variables, dark mode overrides, and custom animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point initializing QueryClient and wrapping App with InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page handling identity, admin checks, inquiry filtering, and rendering site content editor.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing branding decisions, issues, and existing features for the app.
